notes.title: LINUX version released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

We are happy to announce that Dawn of Mages has launched for Linux too.
It is early access.
Have fun and feel free to report bugs on [url=steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FfDWNXxvnY3]Discord[/url].

[b]Note: Linux and Windows players CAN play together, in the same lobby.[/b]

Sincerely,
TwoShrinks

notes.title: The Big Day! Dawn of Mages Launched!
notes.notes:
You saw the TRAILER, you read all kinds of details.

It is time YOU see and feel what we're talking about.

Tune in, purchase the game, enjoy the Early Access benefits, play the game, win and contribute to shaping the future of Dawn of Mages.

See you on the battlefield!


Known bugs (soon to be fixed):
- Some UI glitches
- Server name does not appear correctly

notes.notes:
Performance tweaks

UI adjustments

notes.title: Introducing Breakable Glass!
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

Umbra Map:
- added BREAKABLE windows using UE5 Chaos Destruction. You can break the glass with spells, melee and running and/or jumping through it
- you can now BREACH down, through the floor and land to the ground floor
- fixed BREACH for the fence
- added more lights
- fixed some footsteps sounds
- other minor fixes

Lost Map:
- collision fixes
- river adjustments

Gameplay:
- added Hit Markers in HUD. Now you know where the damage comes from
- added visual hit markers when you damage enemies
- removed audio hit marker when you damage enemies

Character:
- fixed weapons position
- visibility tweak
- tweaked ragdoll
- animations performance improvements
- movement rework

Spells:
- added Continuous Collision Detection. No more stray  spells
- fixed ICE Ultimate Spell
- adjusted Snipe and Bolt hit area. It was too small
- tweaked Bolt

Sounds:
- added reverb and EQ
- fixed bolt sounds triggering many times

Video:
- added vsync toggle

notes.title: The Lost World
notes.notes:
NEW MAP!

We are introducing: Lost - Explore a forgotten world! A war was lost here and now dragons reign supreme. Beware the lost world and fight among the ancients…

General:
- ALL characters in random rotation for both player and bots
- Added more graphics options
- Added NVIDIA DLSS and NIS
- Overall animation performance improvements
- Added sound when player hits enemy 
- Added sound when player kills enemy
- Added visual kill marker
- Added SPACE key to respawn because clicking the button was too slow

Fixes and changes:
- Some characters: adjusted clothes and other items
- Lost map: reworked collision for some items, reworked water (river), fixed some "fall through map" zones
- Umbra map: reworked collision for some items, added more lights, added more zones to use Breach spell
- Breach spell: revorked logic and added smoke. 30s cooldown, 15s lifetime
- Bolt spells: increased "hit" area
- Menu: changed some item placements
- Added "FPS" text to the fps counter top right

Others:
- Temporarily removed AMD FSR due to random crashes

notes.title: Introducing the Breach Spell!
notes.notes:
[b]General Changes:[/b]
- Changed CUT spell with BREACH. New mechanic. You need to face a wall or prop to trigger.
[i]Not all walls or props accept BREACH. It's up to you to discover. It has 30s cooldown and 15s lifespan.[/i]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
- CLOSE spells now have 500ms cooldown. It was overpowered as instant
- Removed contour line
- Made characters more visible
- Climb animation is now faster. Players were vulnerable for too long

[b]Map Changes:[/b]
- Redesigned pool rooftop, it was impairing movement
- Adjusted overall lighting
- Adjusted wall-torches light intensity, made them brighter
- Redesigned stairs to look better

[b]Other[/b]
- Fixed random rare crash. Please use our discord server if you find more

[b]Thank you[/b]

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Based on our first feedback from the community, we modified/added the following:
[list]
[*]Modified the stairs from the pool for a better navigation flow
[*]Adjusted Health PowerUp height and visibility
[*]More challenging bots - they now use the "Close" class of spells too
[*]Added AMD FidelityFX 2.2 - more FPS for everybody
[*]Adjusted lights and shadows for better performance
[*]Fixed a bug in the AoE spell class
[/list]
